comment: An organisation policy: which MCP servers may run at all. Keep it in one place (a repo every project vendors, or a managed path) and point projects at it with "extends": "<path>" in their own .mcp-vault.policy.json, or set MCP_VAULT_ORG_POLICY. A project file can only tighten it: a looser value is a policy error, not a quiet override. An allow list means default deny — a server not on it, including one the vault DB does not know, is refused; a deny rule outranks every allow. githubOwner admits only a repository source_binding verified; entry admits only a launch of that entry's own package. toolApproval: require blocks any new or changed tool until `mcp-vault approve <server>` records it in mcp.lock.json.

allow.reason: internal, not in the vault DB
